mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned flagship copper-gold-silver porphyry in southern Peru. Updated MRE filed Feb 2024 (eff. Nov 20, 2023; QP Paul Daigle, P.Geo., AGP Mining Consultants; CIM best practices): Indicated 507.3 Mt @ 0.34% Cu, 0.20 g/t Au, 2.42 g/t Ag, 0.0021% Mo; Inferred 496.0 Mt @ 0.27% Cu, 0.17 g/t Au, 2.53 g/t Ag, 0.0027% Mo; 0.15% CuEq cutoff within optimized pit shell (strip ratio 0.65:1). Higher-grade component at 0.5% CuEq cutoff also disclosed. 2026 plan: 15,000 m drill program (infill at North Pit, stepout at South Pit, skarn targets). Updating mine plan prioritizing high-grade starter pit. Wheaton Precious Metals PMPA: $140M in instalments (current portion $12M liability). Also holds four early-stage Peru projects and a diluted ~6.31% interest in Antilla Copper plus a 2% NSR (with TABB buyback option).

notes: No production, no revenue; no reserves (exploration stage). FY2025 annual MD&A dated April 30, 2026 (USD). Cash of US$0.49M at Dec 31, 2025. Working capital deficiency of US$14.6M (includes US$12M current portion of Wheaton PMPA; adjusted deficiency US$2.6M). 2025-2026 financings: C$3.44M LIFE offering (Dec 2025) + C$4.0M non-brokered placement (Feb 2026). QP: Luis Vela. Figures read directly from the SEDAR+ MD&A document page (HTML rendering).
